This discrepancy is disclosed and its cause remains unverified; no street-number renumbering or identical entrance is asserted. The operator historical announcement identifies FRA03 as its second separate Schwalbach data centre on the former Samsung property. locator.precision: The first complete registered chimney coordinate explicitly associated with FRA03 anchors the existing campus. This is an equipment point, not a campus centroid, building footprint, entrance or data hall. The six source equipment points are not six data centres.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The register supplies no horizontal positional accuracy. ETRS89/UTM is specified by the corresponding official registration form. Integer source metres and seven output decimals are representation, not survey accuracy. The operator street number 6 and register number 7 differ; the cause is unresolved.
